## HostBackendCapabilities type

Capabilities a host-implemented [HostSecretBackend](./wasm.hostsecretbackend.md) may advertise.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type HostBackendCapabilities = Record<string, unknown>;
```

## Remarks

Kept as a loose passthrough on purpose: the authoritative Rust-side capability shape (`BackendCapabilities`<!-- -->) is owned by issue \#242, which had not landed when this contract was published. This type is the seam that lets a host probe/report capabilities today without inventing a parallel convention; expect its shape to narrow once \#242 lands.
